milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining an oak door (wooden door) drops the oak_door item into the player's inventory. The player starts without any oak_door in inventory, so having ≥1 confirms the block was successfully mined.

Uses inventory_has because crafting oak_slabs (3 oak_planks → 6 oak_slabs at a crafting table) places the slabs into the player's inventory. The player starts with no oak_slabs, so having ≥1 confirms the crafting recipe was completed.

Uses inventory_has because crafting an iron_sword (2 iron_ingots + 1 stick in a crafting table) places the sword into the player's inventory. The player starts with no iron_sword, so having ≥1 confirms the crafting recipe was completed.

Uses inventory_has because mining a damaged_anvil with a pickaxe drops the damaged_anvil item into the player's inventory. The player starts with no damaged_anvil in inventory and has a stone_pickaxe (required tool tier). Having ≥1 confirms the block was successfully mined.

scene_description: A 9x9 stone platform in a forest clearing with an oak door near spawn, a crafting table in the middle, and a damaged anvil at the far corner. The player starts with 2 iron ingots, a stone pickaxe, and 6 oak planks. Task flow: mine the nearby oak door → craft oak slabs at the crafting table → craft an iron sword at the crafting table → mine the damaged anvil at the far end with the stone pickaxe.
task_text: Mine the oak door, then craft oak slabs and an iron sword at the crafting table, and finally mine the damaged anvil with your pickaxe.
design_notes: Platform expanded to 9x9 (from ~-3 to ~5 in both X and Z). Oak door placed close to spawn at (~1,~0,~1) for easy first task. Crafting table at (~3,~0,~1) in the middle for both crafting tasks. Damaged anvil at (~4,~0,~4) at the far corner — intentionally placed further away as it's the final task. Player given 6 oak planks (3 for slabs + 2 for sticks + 1 spare), 2 iron ingots, and stone pickaxe. Air cleared 4 blocks high above platform to prevent tree interference.
